title: Settings
content:
### Settings

#### Date
This setting is available for all list types. When calculating released and remaining value on accruals, the date entered here will be taken into consideration. In the list you will see the accruals up to the date you selected here. The default date is the last day of the current period.

#### Include fully released
This setting is only available for the list type Standard. With this setting you determine if the list should include all accruals up to and including the selected date. Fully released accruals will be included if you check this box, otherwise you will only see the accruals where there is something left to release.

#### Include released
This setting is only available for the list type Period allocation. With this setting you determine if the list should include accruals which have been released during the accounting year in question.

#### Only accrual accounts
This setting is not available for the list type Reconciliation by accrual. With this setting you determine if the list should be based on accrual accounts, that is, only on accounts with the setting Accrual account entered in the chart of accounts. This is equivalent to pasting a selection in the account selection only containing accounts referring to accrual accounting.

#### Only canceled accruals
This setting is only available for the list type Standard. With this setting you decide if the list should only display accruals which have been canceled.

title: The Period allocation list
content:
### The Period allocation list
This list type shows period amounts for each accrual. The list is the same as the standard list except each period being more detailed. One row for each last date of an accrual is shown.

title: Getting started
content:
# Getting started
Welcome to Monitor ERP! This section of the online help is intended for those of you that are new users of the ERP system. Monitor ERP is primarily used as a program installed in Windows.
The program is also available as a mobile client, Monitor Mobile, which you can run in a browser or in an app for Android and IOS. Monitor Mobile is ideal for use in warehouses. Here you can read about the [user interface](../Interface/Interface.htm) and different [functions](../GeneralFeatures/GeneralFeatures.htm) in the program and about [Monitor Mobile](MobileClient.htm). If you are a system administrator you can read about how to [configure](../InstallConfig/Configuration.htm) Monitor ERP.
Before you start your training in the ERP system and before going live, there are different default settings which need to be controlled and possibly changed. Different basic data should also be registered. If the company is converting from Monitor G4, all data will be included, except for certain basic data which needs to be registered again. If the company changes from another ERP system to Monitor ERP you can import parts, customers, and suppliers from your old ERP system. The work regarding basic data needs to be performed before you can create inquiries, quotes, different orders, etc.
Read more about the basic data you normally should register in the [Basic data and settings](../Using/RegisterBasicData/BasicDataSettings.htm) topic.
In the online help function you can read more about [order flows](../Using/Flows/OrderFlows.htm), [how to use MONITOR](../Using/UsingMONITOR.htm), and [options](../Options/Options.htm). There are different order flows you need to have knowledge of to understand how uou work with inquiries, quotes, and different orders in Monitor ERP. These Monitor ERP options are purchased separately.
> The system administrator must register users and also needs to configure different parts of the system before you can start using Monitor ERP. When you register new users, the Force password setting is activated. This settings requires you to enter a password of a certain length and complexity for the user. You can read more about how the password policy and multifactor authentication (MFA) work in the [Security settings](../../GeneralRegisters/BasicSettings/SecuritySettings/wSecuritySettings.htm) section.

title: Monitor Mobile
content:
### Monitor Mobile
A mobile client, Monitor Mobile, is provided with Monitor ERP. This can be run in a regular browser or as an app on Android or IOS. Monitor Mobile has a clear focus on what is most important for the mobile work flow, quick and easy reporting and a reduced need of printouts. Before using Monitor Mobile, Monitor ERP web server must be installed, and a few settings must be configured for those who are going to use Monitor Mobile.
> You can read more about the procedures and other features in the online help for Monitor Mobile which is available in [English](https://help.monitor.se/en/monitor_g5_web/latest/Content/Topics/Home.htm) and [Swedish](https://help.monitor.se/sv/monitor_g5_web/latest/Content/Topics/Home.htm).
Settings on user
Settings which need to be configured by the administrator under the Security tab in the Users procedure in the Windows client.
![](https://help.monitorerp.cn/CN-MONITOR_G5/en-us/Content/Resources/Images/UserGuide/SettingsWebUser.png)
- Activate the Allow login to Monitor Mobile setting. When the setting is activated, one of the following settings must also be entered.Enter a password in the Password field. The password is then used when logging into Monitor Mobile. Link an account in Windows to the user with the Windows account setting. Then you do not have to enter a password in the password field. In this case, the Windows account password is used when logging into Monitor Mobile.
Installation of web server for Monitor Mobile
To use Monitor Mobile and the app, the Monitor ERP Web server must be installed in your network. If your IT department or your IT supplier should handle the installation, you find an installation guide [här](../InstallConfig/InstallMONITORWebServer.htm). If you need new installation files, you can contact the Monitor Support Center by phone: +46 650 766 03 or by e-mail: support@monitorerp.com The installation of the web server can also be performed by a technician from the Monitor Support Center.
Web browser
Monitor Mobile can be run on a modern web browser with support for HTML5.
You get the address to the web server by your administrator. When you have entered the address in the web browser, a login page is shown. There you enter your user name in Monitor ERP and the password supplied by your administrator. Alternatively, it is the same password you use for your Windows account.
![](https://help.monitorerp.cn/CN-MONITOR_G5/en-us/Content/Resources/Images/UserGuide/WebLogin.png)
App for Android and IOS
You can also run Monitor Mobile as an app on smartphones and tablets. There is support for Android and IOS. You can download the app from Google Play, where it's called Monitor Mobile, or from Apple App Store where it’s called Monitor G5.
![](https://help.monitorerp.cn/CN-MONITOR_G5/en-us/Content/Resources/Images/UserGuide/MONAppG5.png)
When you start the app for the first time you are directed to the page for settings. There you enter the URL (web address) to the web server and you can choose if notifications should be displayed on the unit. You get the information about the web server's URL from your administrator.
Procedures in Monitor Mobile
Monitor Mobile client currently contains the below procedures that are suitable for use on smartphones and tablets. You have the same user rights in these procedures as you have in the corresponding procedures (and warehouse) in the Windows client.
Manufacturing
- Pick list A pick list is a list of parts/products which should be picked from stock for a manufacturing order or a customer order.
Purchase
- Report arrival
- Approve purchase order
- Authorize invoice
- Receiving inspection
- Undo arrival reporting
Sales
- Customer list
- CRM view
- Report delivery (pick list)
Stock
- Part list
- Stock count
- Stock count in list
- Create stock count list
- Move stock balance
- Priority plan – Stock
- Direct withdrawal
- Direct arrival
- Register case
- Case list
Time recording
- Attendance list
- Recording terminal
Accounting
- Signing payments
> You can read more about the procedures and other features in the online help for Monitor Mobile, which is available in [English](https://help.monitor.se/en/monitor_g5_web/latest/Content/Topics/Home.htm) and [Swedish](https://help.monitor.se/sv/monitor_g5_web/latest/Content/Topics/Home.htm).

title: Monitor BI
content:
## Monitor BI

#### Smarter decisions with clear visualizations
Monitor BI is a function that converts your company’s data into valuable insights. With this function you get the tools you need to simply and effectively analyze data, create compelling visualizations, and make smarter decisions.
In Monitor BI there is a wide selection of preinstalled dashboards and an editing feature which enables you to create new dashboards and customize existing dashboards.

#### Why choose Monitor BI:
- Gathers data in one place
- Create dashboards and KPIs
- Web-based
- Standard in Monitor ERP

#### Getting started
On [this](https://help.monitorerp.com/en-monitor-bi/sv-se/Content/Topics/GettingStarted.htm) page, you can read more about the requirements and recommendations and what you need to do before you log into Monitor BI for the first time.
> Monitor BI has its own online help site, please click [here](https://help.monitorerp.com/en-monitor-bi/sv-se/Content/Home.htm) to access it.

title: 设置
content:
### 设置

#### 日期
此设置可用于除以下列表类型之外的全部成本。计算应计提的已释放和剩余值时，将考虑此处输入的日期。你将在列表中看到截至你在此处已选择的日期的计提。默认日期是当前期间的最后日。

#### 包括已完全释放
此设置仅可用于列表类型 标准。通过此设置，你可以确定列表是否应包括截至已选择日期的全部计提。如果你检查此框，则将包含完全已释放的计提，否则你将仅看到左边需释放的计提。

#### 包括已释放的
此设置仅可用于列表类型 期间分配。通过此设置，你可以确定列表是否应包括在相关会计年度内已已释放的计提。

#### 仅计提会计
此设置不可用用于列表类型 计提对账。通过此设置，你可以确定列表是否应基于应计科目，即仅基于具有设置的科目 计提科目 已 输入会计科目表.这相当于在科目选择中粘贴仅包含涉及计提会计的科目的选择。

#### 仅删除计提
此设置仅可用于列表类型 标准。通过此设置，你可以决定列表是否仅显示已已取消的计提。

title: 期间分配列表
content:
### 期间分配列表
此列表类型显示每个应计项目的期间金额。该列表与标准列表相同，只是每个期间更多详细。每个应行的最后日期显示一。

title: 已开始
content:
# 已开始
欢迎来到 Monitor ERP！在线帮助功能中的此章节你主要针对 ERP系统的新用户和系统管理员。Monitor ERP 主要用作安装在 Windows 中的程序。该程序还有一个网络客户端。它可以在常规的网络浏览器中运行，也可以作为 Android 和 IOS 的应用程序运行。你可以在这里阅读 [用户界面](../Interface/Interface.htm) 和不同的 [功能](../GeneralFeatures/GeneralFeatures.htm) 在程序中以及关于 [网络客户端](WebClient.htm)。如果你是系统管理员，你可以阅读如何 [配置](../InstallConfig/Configuration.htm) Monitor ERP。
在你开始ERP系统培训和上线之前，有不同的默认设置需要控制并可能已变更。还应已登记不同的基础数据。如果公司从MONITOR G4 转换而来，则会包含全部数据，除了需要重新已登记的某些基础数据。如果公司从其他 ERP系统变更为 Monitor ERP 你可以从旧的ERP系统导入组件、客户和供应商。在你创建询价、报价、不同的订单等之前，需要执行有关基础数据的工作。
阅读更多基础数据你通常登记在 [基础数据和设置](../Using/RegisterBasicData/BasicDataSettings.htm) 话题。
在在线帮助功能中，你可以阅读更多关于 [订单流](../Using/Flows/OrderFlows.htm)， [如何使用MONITOR](../Using/UsingMONITOR.htm)， 和 [选项](../Options/Options.htm)。你需要了解不同的订单流程，以了解如何你询价、报价和不同的订单。 Monitor ERP。这些 Monitor ERP 选项需单独采购件。
> 系统管理员必须登记用户，并且还需要配置系统的不同组件，之前你开始使用 Monitor ERP。

title: Web客户端
content:
### Web客户端
Web客户端被用于在 Monitor ERP。它可以在常规的浏览器中运行，也可以作为 Android 或 IOS 上的应用程序运行。不过，Web客户端的程序和功能比Windows客户端要少。在你使用 Web客户端之前， Monitor ERP 必须安装 Web服务器，并且必须为将使用 Web客户端的用户已配置一些设置。
用户设置
设置已配置管理员在 安全 标签页卡中的 用户 Windows客户端中的程序。
![](https://help.monitorerp.cn/CN-MONITOR_G5/zh-cn/Content/Resources/Images/UserGuide/SettingsWebUser.png)
- 激活 允许登录Web客户端 设置。当已激活该设置时，还必须输入以下设置一。在中输入密码 密码 字段。然后用于该密码登录Web客户端。 使用以下方式将 Windows 中的科目链接到用户 Windows账户 设置。然后你不在密码字段中输入密码。在这种案件下，日志Web客户端时将使用Windows账户的密码。
安装Web服务器
为了能够使用 Web客户端和应用程序， Monitor ERP 您的网络中必须安装 Web服务器。支持服务器的实际的安装执行由来自 Monitor ERP 系统有限公司。
网页浏览器
网络客户端可以在支持HTML5 的现代网络浏览器上运行。
你可以从管理员处获取 Web服务器的地址。当你在网络浏览器中输入地址时，将显示登录页。在输入你的您的用户名称 Monitor ERP 以及管理员供应由的密码。或者，它与你用于Windows账户的密码相同。
![](https://help.monitorerp.cn/CN-MONITOR_G5/zh-cn/Content/Resources/Images/UserGuide/WebLogin.png)
适用于Android和IOS的应用程序
你还可以在智能手机和平板计算机上将网络客户端作为应用程序运行。支持Android 和 IOS。你从 Google Play 或 Apple App Store下载该应用程序。该应用程序名为“Monitor ERP“。
![](https://help.monitorerp.cn/CN-MONITOR_G5/zh-cn/Content/Resources/Images/UserGuide/MONAppG5.png)
第一个你该应用程序时，你时间被定向到设置页。你可以在此处输入Web服务器的 URL（地址），并你选择是否在单位上显示通知。你可以从管理员处获取有关 Web 服务器 URL 的信息。
